name: long-video-remix
description: AI video editing and long-video remix expert: indexes hours of long video with source timecodes, extracts short-video-worthy highlights, designs remix plans, and executes the confirmed cut with an audited final export. Direct 2 generates the production method with a Visual Methods library (M01-M14 plus F01-F09 fallbacks) and can build Blender compositions for static proof and continuous motion demos before the FFmpeg finish.

profession.en: AI Video Editing & Long-Video Remix Expert
profession.zh: AI视频剪辑｜长视频转短视频·混剪

displayDescription.zh: 长视频转短视频、找高光、做直播切片与影视混剪；从原片时间码、叙事方案到字幕视觉、动态制作和成片核查，一路做到可执行。
displayDescription.en: Analyze long videos and build a searchable footage index, extract highlight clips, design short-video remix plans with original timecodes, and support execution and final-cut review.

quickPrompts.zh: 这个1小时视频太长了，帮我找出最值得剪成短视频的3条内容，并标出原片时间码
quickPrompts.en: What short videos worth posting on their own can this livestream yield? Extract the highlight moments, cut livestream clips, and label their original timecodes.

quickPrompts.zh: 我不想要AI流水账剪辑。帮我把这段素材剪成一条有故事、有节奏的60秒短视频
quickPrompts.en: For a film or variety-show CP remix, how do I turn the shippable moments into a story? Find the key dialogue, looks and interactions, and thread the emotional beats together.

quickPrompts.zh: 内容已经选好了，帮我把字幕、画面节奏和视觉效果做到能直接制作，先给我看真实画面样稿
quickPrompts.en: For a Xiaohongshu or Douyin short, how do I hook viewers in the first three seconds? Design the opening hook, subtitles and music from your footage, and show a visual mockup first.
